question: Which lens did I say I bought right before the Big Sur trip?

haystack_sessions.content: The rear derailleur on my commuter bike keeps skipping in third gear.
That usually means the cable has stretched. Try a quarter turn on the barrel adjuster.
My sourdough starter finally doubled overnight after a week of nothing.
The warmer kitchen probably did it. Feeding twice a day should keep it lively.
I bought a 35mm prime lens the week before the Big Sur trip.
A good call for coastal landscapes. Did you shoot much at the overlooks?
I shot the whole Big Sur trip on that 35mm prime and never swapped it off.
One lens the whole way keeps you moving. Any shot you wish you had gone wider for?
The dentist wants me back in six months for the other filling.
Worth booking now while the slot is open. They fill up fast in the fall.
